message.content: On January 29, 2026, the Turkish Football Federation issued a fine of 802,500 lira (approximately $18,500) to the Diyarbakır-based club Amed S.F.K. Additionally, the club's president, Nahit Eren, was suspended on charges of "making ideological propaganda" after the club uploaded a video related to protests against the 2026 northeastern Syria offensive.
